reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. I checked transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to your Access Bank account 0234567891). Although our system had marked it as failed, I asked your bank for the final status, and they confirm the money was successfully credited to your account on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 (UTC).

Confirmation details:
- Transfer reference: TRF-INV-88
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Please check your account statement — it may have landed under a slightly different date or descriptor than expected. If it still doesn't appear, kindly quote the session ID above to your Access Bank branch and they'll be able to trace it.

I have not resent the payment, since your bank confirms the original ₦250,000 was credited — resending would result in a duplicate payment. Let me know what your bank says and I'll help further if needed.

Best regards,
Operations, Mama's Kitchen

[after the person answered]

Good afternoon Chidi,

I understand this is frustrating, and I re-checked just now: Access Bank's own system again confirms the ₦250,000 was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02, session ID 000014261121140211000088.

Because the recipient bank confirms the money landed, I'm not able to send it a second time for now — if it is sitting in your account somewhere, we would end up paying the invoice twice. I hope you'll understand that we have to go on the bank's confirmation here.

Here's what will resolve it fastest:

1. Please visit or call your Access Bank branch and ask them to trace the credit using these details:
   - Amount: ₦250,000
   - Session ID: 000014261121140211000088
   - Date: 21 November 2026, around 14:02
   - Reference: TRF-INV-88

2. Also worth checking: if you hold more than one account with Access Bank, please confirm which account ends in 7891 — the credit was made to that specific number.

As soon as your bank's trace shows the money never actually landed in your account (in which case their earlier status was wrong), I'll resend the ₦250,000 to you immediately — just let me know what they find and I'll act on it right away.

Best regards,
Operations, Mama's Kitchen
